summary: Pull day, so the plate leans on lean turkey and chicken with the wellness-bar protein smoothie pre-workout; cod at lunch adds some variety and omega-3s alongside a chicken add-on for extra protein.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Turkey and an everything bagel with almond butter and Greek yogurt for steady protein and carbs.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Herb-roasted cod as the main with a grilled chicken add-on for extra protein, whole grain pasta and multigrain bread for carbs.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Wellness-bar protein smoothie plus banana, low fat and easy to digest before lifting.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Chicken pizza plus extra chicken breast and whole grain pasta to close out protein and carbs for the day.
